steps.en: The offence rule list is generated automatically every day
steps.id: Daftar offence rule dibuat otomatis setiap hari
steps.why_en: The automatic daily run is switched off in the production settings in the repo.
steps.why_id: Jadwal harian otomatis dimatikan di pengaturan produksi dalam repo.

steps.en: The offence rule codes in effect today are selected
steps.id: Kode offence rule yang berlaku hari ini dipilih

steps.en: A fixed-format offence rule file is built
steps.id: File offence rule berformat tetap dibuat

steps.en: The file is encrypted and sent to REPCCS
steps.id: File dienkripsi lalu dikirim ke REPCCS
